description: A Flutter widget class for displaying a list of notes, with functionalities including search, refresh, navigation to note detail/edit pages, and note management options like pin/unpin and delete.

classes.name: NotesListPage
classes.description: StatefulWidget that displays a list of notes with search and management features.

classes.name: _NotesListPageState
classes.description: State class for NotesListPage, manages UI and user interactions.

classes.name: _OceanFab
classes.description: Custom FloatingActionButton widget for creating new notes.

methods.name: _goToCreate
